summary: _ansible_version passes the Ansible version to modules, accessible as AnsibleModule.ansible_version (2.1+).
questions: How can a module find out which Ansible version is running it?

answer_card.title: _ansible_version
answer_card.answer_md: Use `module.ansible_version` after instantiating `AnsibleModule` (replaces `ANSIBLE_VERSION` from module_replacer). Added in 2.1.
